Message__c: Unit test uses SeeAllData=true which exposes tests to real org data and creates dependency on existing records.
Remediation__c: Replace @isTest(SeeAllData=true) with proper test data setup using @testSetup methods or TestDataFactory.

Message__c: Unit test method contains no assertions — the test proves nothing and will always pass even if the code is broken.
Remediation__c: Add at least one System.assert() / System.assertEquals() / System.assertNotEquals() call to verify expected behavior.

Message__c: Test method is missing the @isTest annotation which may cause it to be excluded from coverage reports.
Remediation__c: Add @isTest annotation to the method.

Message__c: Test method is defined outside a class annotated with @isTest — coverage may be unreliable.
Remediation__c: Move the test method into a dedicated @isTest class.

Message__c: Apex code performs DML in a method callable via a GET request exposing it to cross-site request forgery.
Remediation__c: Guard DML with @ReadOnly on the controller or move state-changing operations to POST-only actions.

Message__c: Apex code passes user-controlled input to PageReference() allowing open redirect attacks.
Remediation__c: Validate and whitelist redirect targets before using them in PageReference.

Message__c: Apex code calls a method known to be dangerous (e.g. Database.executeBatch with uncontrolled input).
Remediation__c: Review the call site and add input validation or replace with a safer alternative.

Message__c: Apex class does not declare a sharing keyword — record-level security may not be enforced for the running user.
Remediation__c: Add 'with sharing' to the class declaration; use 'inherited sharing' when the sharing context should come from the caller.

Message__c: Apex code builds a SOQL query by concatenating unvalidated user input — allows an attacker to manipulate the query.
Remediation__c: Use bind variables (:variable) in SOQL instead of string concatenation with user-controlled input.

Message__c: Method or class exceeds the Non Commenting Source Statements (NCSS) threshold indicating excessive complexity.
Remediation__c: Refactor by extracting logic into smaller single-responsibility methods or classes.

Message__c: Method has too many parameters making it hard to call and test.
Remediation__c: Introduce a parameter object or break the method into smaller focused methods.

Message__c: Method is defined but never called — it is dead code that adds maintenance overhead.
Remediation__c: Remove the unused method or add appropriate tests/callers if it was intended to be used.

Message__c: Local variable is declared and assigned but never read.
Remediation__c: Remove the variable or use it if the assignment was intentional.

Message__c: Catch block is empty — exceptions are silently swallowed making failures invisible.
Remediation__c: Log the exception or rethrow it; never silently ignore errors.

Message__c: If statement body is empty — likely a logic error or forgotten implementation.
Remediation__c: Remove the empty if or implement the intended behavior.

Message__c: Statement block is empty with no comments explaining why.
Remediation__c: Implement the intended logic or add an explanatory comment if the empty block is deliberate.

Message__c: Try or finally block is empty which defeats the purpose of structured exception handling.
Remediation__c: Add meaningful code to the try block or remove the unnecessary try/finally.

Message__c: While loop body is empty — this is almost always a logic error.
Remediation__c: Add the intended loop body or replace with a more appropriate construct.

Message__c: Apex code contains a hardcoded Salesforce record ID — IDs differ between orgs and change after sandboxes are refreshed.
Remediation__c: Use Custom Labels or SOQL to look up the record dynamically instead of hardcoding its ID.

Message__c: Multiple variables are declared on a single line reducing readability.
Remediation__c: Declare each variable on its own line.

Message__c: For loop body is not enclosed in braces — adding statements later may silently break logic.
Remediation__c: Wrap the for loop body in curly braces.

Message__c: If/else branches are not enclosed in braces — adding statements later may silently break logic.
Remediation__c: Wrap each if/else branch in curly braces.

Message__c: While loop body is not enclosed in braces — adding statements later may silently break logic.
Remediation__c: Wrap the while loop body in curly braces.

Message__c: If statement body is not enclosed in braces — adding statements later may silently break logic.
Remediation__c: Wrap the if body in curly braces.

Message__c: Apex code performs SOQL queries or DML inside a loop — consumes governor limits rapidly and fails on bulk operations.
Remediation__c: Move all SOQL/DML outside loops; use collections and bulkification patterns.

Message__c: DescribeSObjectResult is loaded eagerly in a loop causing redundant expensive describe calls.
Remediation__c: Cache the DescribeSObjectResult outside the loop and reuse it.

Message__c: Class or method uses global access modifier making it part of the package's public API permanently.
Remediation__c: Use public instead of global unless the class is intentionally part of an installable package API.
